name: Parameters.prod_varpi_eq_rootDiscr_pow
summary: ∏_v v(ϖ) is the square root of |N(ϖ)| = N(different) = |disc E| = (rd_E^f)².

steps.claim: Take square roots of the product formula ∏_w w(ϖ)^{mult(w)} = |N_{E/ℚ}(ϖ)| and of N((ϖ)) = N(different of E) (`different_eq_span_varpi`).
steps.lean: rcases congr(√$(prod_eq_abs_norm (P.ϖ s).val)), congr(√$(@different_eq_span_varpi P s).absNorm)

steps.claim: Every infinite place of E is complex (multiplicity 2), so ∏_v v(ϖ) = √|N(ϖ)|; N(different) = |disc E| (`absNorm_differentIdeal`) = (rd_E^f)² (`abs_discr_eq_rootDiscr_pow`), and rd_E > 0.
